text: I enjoy working with tools, machines, or my hands.
I'd rather build or fix something than talk about it.
I like figuring out how things work or why things happen.
I enjoy solving complex problems or puzzles.
I like expressing myself through art, music, or writing.
I prefer open-ended tasks with room for creativity over strict rules.
I enjoy helping, teaching, or caring for other people.
I find it rewarding to support someone through a problem.
I like persuading, leading, or motivating others.
I enjoy taking initiative on business or organizational goals.
I like organizing data, records, or details methodically.
I prefer clear procedures over ambiguous, open-ended tasks.
I push myself to set and reach high goals.
I adjust easily when plans or circumstances change.
I double-check details so nothing gets missed.
I carefully weigh risks before making a decision.
I work well as part of a team.
People can count on me to follow through on commitments.
I try to understand how others are feeling before responding.
I'm comfortable admitting when I don't know something.
I take action without waiting to be told what to do.
I like coming up with new ideas or approaches.
I'm honest even when the truth is inconvenient.
I enjoy learning new things for their own sake.
I'm comfortable directing or guiding a group.
I generally expect things to work out well.
I keep going even when a task gets difficult or tedious.
I feel confident in my ability to handle new challenges.
I stay calm and composed even when frustrated.
I mean what I say and say what I mean.
I enjoy being around and interacting with other people.
I stay steady and effective under pressure or tight deadlines.
I'm comfortable moving forward even when a situation is unclear.
